landing.heroSub: Super Toto Local connects you with nearby totos & e-rickshaws in minutes — with live tracking, transparent fares, GST, surge pricing, UPI/Cash/Card payments and Face Recognition login.
landing.featureBookSub: Set pickup & drop on the map, see the fare instantly, tap to request.
landing.featureTrackSub: Watch your toto approach in real time over WebSockets.
landing.featureDriverSub: Go online, accept nearby ride requests, complete trips and earn.
landing.featureAdminSub: Approve drivers, monitor rides and track revenue.
landing.featurePaySub: Pay by UPI, Card or Cash after every ride, with transparent GST, surge pricing and driver commission.
landing.featureRateSub: Rate your driver and rider to keep the community trusted.

riderhome.introLead: Pick a pickup point and drop on the map (click to set).
riderhome.introReserved: Riders reserve the whole vehicle and pay the full trip fare — available seats are shown so you know what you're getting.
riderhome.introShared: Book seats on a shared trip (you only pay for the seats you book), or join a trip that has empty seats.
riderhome.introOff: Rides are currently booked for the whole trip (1 passenger).
riderhome.seatNoteReserved: This is a reserved vehicle — booking it reserves ALL seats for you and you pay the full trip fare. No other rider can join.
riderhome.seatNoteShared: This trip is shared — you only pay for the seats you book. An accepted driver's empty seats can be filled by other riders on the same route.
riderhome.seatNoteOff: Seat booking is currently off — this trip is booked for the whole vehicle (1 passenger).
riderhome.luggageExtra: Extra luggage: {{fare}} added to trip fare
riderhome.luggageFirstFree: First bag is free (up to 5 kg). Extra bags ₹10 each.
riderhome.footnoteReserved: * You reserve the whole {{count}}-seat vehicle — booking a ride pays the full trip fare and no other rider can join. Time estimates are approximate.
riderhome.footnoteShared: * Only pay for the seats you book. If others join, they pay their own seats. Time estimates are approximate.
riderhome.footnoteOff: * This ride is billed for the whole trip. Time estimates are approximate.
riderhome.activeRequests: {{count}} active request(s) · {{drivers}} driver(s) online — surge adjusts automatically.
riderhome.selectDrop: Select a drop to see the fare estimate.
riderhome.bikeSub: Driver provides helmet. 1 rider seat available on a bike.
riderhome.joinTitle: Join a shared trip with empty seats
riderhome.joinSub: Trips are listed for a short window after a driver accepts and before the trip starts. Join to fill the empty seats — you pay only for your own seats.
riderhome.noSharedTrips: No trips with empty seats right now. New trips appear here after a driver accepts.
riderhome.walletEmpty: No transactions yet. Top up to pay for trips from your wallet.
riderhome.howReserveWhole: See the vehicle's available seats, then reserve the whole vehicle.
riderhome.howBookSeats: Book the seats you need — you pay only for those seats.
riderhome.howNearestDriver: Your request goes to the nearest online driver (25s to accept).
riderhome.howJoinEmpty: Once a driver accepts, other riders can join your empty seats.
riderhome.howPay: Pay by UPI, Cash or Card at the end of your trip.
riderhome.noDriverNotice: No totos were available nearby. Please try again.
